prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, late 30s goddess, apex siren physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sculpted updo copper red hair — wearing a skin-tight micro summer school uniform set, a cropped camisole top of ultra-thin glossy pale-pink silk satin with thin spaghetti straps, a lace-trimmed neckline and a small ribbon bow at the center of its neckline, her shoulders and arms bare, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the silk satin fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and an ultra-micro wrap skirt of ultra-thin glossy cream silk satin tied in a small bow at her hip, the wrap opening in a slit up the side to her hip bone, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending a hand-width below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin silk satin molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the lace-trimmed neckline, the small ribbon bow and the liquid sheen against her bare shoulders, fine pull lines and a liquid satin sheen. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg, her legs fully in view — most extreme apex siren silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy pale pink leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in pale pink lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a bright empty ice rink with a clean white ice surface, a waist-high boards edge and standard-height gates, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
